hints.title: Bidirectional State Transitions
hints.text: Maintain count arrays for endpoints transitioning upwards and downwards.

hints.title: Cumulative Frequency Sweeps
hints.text: Use running cumulative totals to transition all states simultaneously in linear time per step.

hints.title: Modulo Arithmetic
hints.text: Perform modulo reductions on cumulative totals at each addition to prevent overflow.

hints.title: Reference Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def numberOfZigzagArrays(self, n: int, m: int) -> int:
        MOD = 1_000_000_007
        if n == 1:
            return m % MOD
        dp_up = [0] * (m + 1)
        dp_down = [0] * (m + 1)
        for v in range(1, m + 1):
            dp_up[v] = v - 1
            dp_down[v] = m - v
            
        for _ in range(3, n + 1):
            next_up = [0] * (m + 1)
            next_down = [0] * (m + 1)
            pref = 0
            for v in range(1, m + 1):
                next_up[v] = pref
                pref = (pref + dp_down[v]) % MOD
            suff = 0
            for v in range(m, 0, -1):
                next_down[v] = suff
                suff = (suff + dp_up[v]) % MOD
            dp_up, dp_down = next_up, next_down
            
        return (sum(dp_up) + sum(dp_down)) % MOD
```

variables: M: upper bound of array entries
complexity.notes: Linear state compression via prefix and suffix cumulative sums.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Brute-force nested loops over previous elements require O(N * M^2) operations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(M) space by only holding current and previous step counts.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize the symmetric dual direction recurrence.
